description: A React component for creating a new team in Mattermost, including UI rendering, routing, and state management.

classes.name: CreateTeam
classes.description: React component class for the create team page, handling UI and logic for team creation.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state with default wizard step and empty team object.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets the document title based on site name when component mounts.

methods.name: updateParent
methods.description: Updates component state and navigates to the next wizard step.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the create team UI, including routing, restrictions, and form components.
